# meshoptimizer probe dependency

Unmodified subset of meshoptimizer 1.1 from Godot revision
`ed1daf0bf001b61586d9930840f2f1394092c079`, matching the engine used by the importer
comparison. Source URLs and SHA-256 digests are recorded in `manifest.json` and
verified by the probe before compilation. This is a test dependency, not yet a
runtime addon dependency.

Copyright Arseny Kapoulkine and contributors. MIT license; the complete copyright
and permission notice is retained at the end of `meshoptimizer.h`. Source headers
retain their original notices. No godot-cpp library is rebuilt.
